acquisition.bodyInterpretation: Nine complete original HTML bodies and one eleven-page original PDF were read. The relevant PDF year/scope and applicant-date pages were rendered and visually inspected. STU had native TLS EOF, one bounded web timeout, and entered cooldown. HIT/NJU different-school landing pages establish no target-school deadline.

rules: Only date-only source observations are certified. No canonical dates, statuses, publication or whole-record freshness were changed.
Four stored exact dates match the official2026 period and are unchanged, with separate past-window observations; they are not counted as new closed-date candidates.
Unknown and blocked cannot establish open/closed availability. STU enters cooldown after one fallback.
HIT cannot prove Harbin Engineering and NJU cannot prove Nanjing Normal. Each broad scholarship ID is counted exactly once; other canonical university mappings are not date-certified.
Independent provincial and institutional awards never borrow general admission cutoffs or another award cutoff.
SUIBE original May10 at24:00 Beijing and successful-system-submission wording are retained verbatim without substituting another clock time.
SYNU original February28 strict-before wording and April14 publication date are both retained; source publication does not imply a deadline extension or reopening.
No year rollover, successor intake inference, programme cessation conclusion or whole-school catalogue certification is made.
Any later mutation requires supported narrow processing, independent approval and comparison with current canonical rows.
